summary: Tape Value get_array, get_object, try_get_array and try_get_object slice the tape one node short, losing the last element of a nested container.
Huge exponents wrap through `as i32` and give wrong finite numbers, while valid very long exponents are rejected.
Fixed-length serde targets leave unread array elements on the tape, which are then read as later values.
A lone high surrogate such as "\ud800" parses as NUL (U+0000) instead of returning an error.
A NUL byte counts as structural-or-whitespace, so a number followed by NUL is accepted.
Long decimals are corrupted because a byte value is used as an index when digit_count is corrected.
